title: Rabbi Zerika (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Tosefta Ohalot, end of chapter 18](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Oholot.18.9): Rabbi Zerika said, “On the fifth of the second Adar twenty-four elders voted on it,” etc. In the [Mekhilta, Beshalach, parashah Vayassa](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Vayassa.5.11), he expounded the verse “And Moses said: Eat it today” — from here, three meals on Shabbat. Hyman attributes this exposition to Rabbi Chidka in [Shabbat 117b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.117b.11). In the consulted text, the Sages require three meals and Rabbi Chidka requires four, both from the same verse.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Tosefta names Rabbi Zerika and records the vote of twenty-four elders. The linked Mekhilta gives Rabbi Hanteka (רבי הנתקה) on three meals, where Hyman gives Zerika. The Bavli gives three meals to the Sages and four to Rabbi Chidka, and the discussion [continues on 118a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.118a.1).
